comparison.objective: Insert a stripped cable end into a lug and close a crimping press to form a durable crimp.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine cable-to-barrel insertion, sustained alignment while operating a lever, extraction, and finished-part handling.
comparison.success_condition: Specified insertion depth and alignment at press closure, lever released, lug retained under pull test, cable removed and returned to its rest.
comparison.reason: PR-741 tests bimanual insertion plus force-forming of a permanent joint. The candidate tests reversible screening of free bodies and retention, not assembly or crimping.
